facts.statement: Baringaspis is an extinct genus containing only one species of arthrodire placoderm fish that lived during the Early Devonian period.
facts.quote: Baringaspis is an extinct monospecific genus of arthrodire placoderm fish from the Early Devonian period.

facts.statement: The type species Baringaspis dineleyi was described in 1973 from fossils found in the Peel Sound Formation on Prince of Wales Island in Arctic Canada.
facts.quote: The type species Baringaspis dineleyi was described in 1973, and was found in the Peel Sound Formation on Prince of Wales Island in Arctic Canada.

facts.statement: Baringaspis is considered one of the most basal members of the order Arthrodira.

facts.statement: Baringaspis belongs to the family Actinolepididae.
Baringaspis is classified within the class Placodermi.
Baringaspis lived during the Lochkovian stage of the Early Devonian, between 419.62 and 413.02 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Lochkovian to Lochkovian (419.62 to 413.02 million years ago)
